orgName: Aramco Championship / Aramco Korea Championship / Aramco China Championship (PIF Global Series)
note: Title Partner of three PIF Global Series events - the Aramco Championship (Shadow Creek, Las Vegas, LPGA/LET co-sanctioned), Aramco Korea Championship (Seoul) and Aramco China Championship (Shenzhen) - per Aramco's own sponsorship site (sponsorships.aramco.com/pif-global-series, fetched 25 Sep 2026); Aramco says its 2026 title events span the US, Korea and China (Aramco Americas news, 2026-04-21). The inaugural Aramco Championship was won by Lauren Coughlin (Aramco Americas, 2026-04-21).
